## Heating Repair Request for Paris Apartment

A polite but firm email you can send to your landlord. It states the issue clearly, includes the timeline, and asks for repair within 5 business days plus written confirmation.

## Email Draft

**Subject:** Urgent heating repair request — [Apartment address]

Dear [Landlord’s Name],

I am writing again regarding the heating problem in my rented apartment at [address]. The heating has been unreliable for **12 days**, and the apartment is only **38 m²**, so the lack of proper heating is affecting the comfort and livability of the home.

I have already reported this issue by text on **2026-01-08** and again on **2026-01-12**, but the problem remains unresolved. With the outside temperature below **8°C** for several days, this situation is becoming increasingly difficult.

Please arrange for the heating to be repaired **within 5 business days** of this message. I would also appreciate **written confirmation** of the repair plan and the expected date of completion.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. I look forward to your reply.

Kind regards,
[Your full name]
[Apartment address]
[Phone number]

## Evidence to Keep

- Copies of the two text messages sent on **2026-01-08** and **2026-01-12**
- Photos or short videos showing the heating not working or performing poorly
- Any thermostat readings or notes on indoor temperature
- A simple log of dates, times, and how long the heating was unavailable
- Any replies from the landlord, agency, or technician
- Utility bills or rent documents showing the apartment address and tenancy details
